# Open_Source_Hardware_Acceleration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The practice of sharing FPGA source code and design files publicly, enabling collaborative development and benchmarking of hardware accelerators. Open-source designs reduce development overhead and foster reproducibility, essential for advancing TCC/iNEST hardware-software co-design.
